why: The same edge read from the other end. A link lives on the node that wrote it, so `-enables->` and `<-enables-` name one edge and answer with opposite nodes — `traversal` forward, `knowledge-graph` backward. This is the only part of the syntax that has to be learned rather than guessed, and it is what makes `direction: out` in `.ont.yml` mean something at query time. A server that walks the adjacency undirected passes the forward case and answers both nodes here.
